2. This writ petition is instituted by the brother of detenu Mohammed Ahmed Hussain, challenging the order of detention dated 15.07.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986).
3. Heard Ms. Ayesha Mohammed, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for home.
4.
The order of detention is resorted to on the ground of involvement in five crimes recently by the detenu.

The detaining authority also took note of the fact that the detenu was in the habit of committing similar crimes and 44 crimes were registered against him between the year 2018 and 2021 in different police stations of Nizamabad Police Commissionerate, on the allegation of theft of two wheeler motor cycles.
It appears the detenu was also involved in the crime registered under Narcotic Drugs And Psychotropic Substances, Act, 1985 in I-Town Police Station, Nizamabad and later he was acquitted.

entities.text: Narcotic Drugs And Psychotropic Substances, Act, 1985
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. All the five crimes which are relied upon to resort to preventively detaining the detenu also relate to theft of motor cycles.
6. We are of the opinion that having regard to the nature of crimes involved, it cannot be said that the involvement in those crimes would disturb the public order.
They are normal law and order crimes.
Ordinary law of the land is sufficient to deal with the situation.
It cannot be said that crimes registered against detenu inevitably lead to harm, danger or alarm or feeling of insecurity among the general public.

7. Having regard to the above, the Writ Petition is allowed and the respondents are directed to set the detenu namely Mohammed Ahmed Hussain S/o.Mohammed Basheer Hussain, Aged : 42 yrs,
Occu :
Labour R/o.H.No.4-2-81, Zainulabuddin Gally, Bhainsa Village and Mandal, Nirmal District at liberty forthwith if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
